chart.title: Share of births registered
chart.subtitle: Percentage of children under age five whose births were registered at the time of the survey. This includes children whose birth certificate was seen by the interviewer or whose mother or caretaker says the birth has been registered.
chart.citation: Household surveys (DHS, MICS), compiled by UNICEF, via World Bank (2026)
